name: Kongming, Fel Eidolon: On Enter, Recover X (X = TERA cards in banishment)
notes: Real level-up required to fire a champion's own On Enter (per kongming-wayward-maven-enter-shifting-currents). Fel Eidolon is level 3 (3-memory cost), so the starting champion is patched to a level-2 champion (84YTQPTvar, satisfies CanChampionLevelUpIntoCard's targetLevel===currentLevel+1 gate) with Fel Eidolon's own CardID also placed in Subcards for TERA element access (GetLegalMaterializeChoices gates champion targets on CanPlayerUseCardElement too, same technique as tera-sight-preserve-draw). RecoverChampion($player, $recoverAmount) reduces the champion field object's own Damage property (GameLogic.php:18386-18390) -- pre-damaging the champion to 5 before the level-up and seeding 2 TERA-element cards (qktid6zlyt, jwanjcy453) in myBanish let the enterAbilities['7x2v4tdop1:0'] macro's ZoneSearch("myBanish", cardElements:["TERA"]) count be observed directly as Damage 5 -> 3.

rulesClauses: On Enter: Recover X. X is equal to the number of Tera cards in your banishment.
